title: feat(highlight): implement InstantSearch.css
body:
This PR add functionalities to highlight hits without manipulating the Algolia response object (`_highlightResult`). It provides two ways to highlight a hit.

## Specs

[See specs →](https://instantsearch-css.netlify.com/widgets/highlight/)

Note that I didn't add the CSS class `ais-Highlight-nonHighlighted` because it complexifies the parsing for not much added value. This is also what we did for Vue InstantSearch.

## API

### As a function

The hit must be explicitly passed to the helper function to retrieve the highlighted value.

```js
instantsearch.highlight({ attribute, highlightedTagName, hit })
// => <mark class="ais-Highlight-highlighted">Amazon</mark> - Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote - Black
```

### As a Hogan template helper

The hit is injected leveraging the `data` prop from the `Template` component, allowing to omit the `hit` parameter when using the Hogan template. The parameters are forwarded to the `highlight()` function.

```js
{{#highlight}}{ "attribute": "name", "highlightedTagName": "mark" }{{/highlight}}
// => <mark class="ais-Highlight-highlighted">Amazon</mark> - Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote - Black
```

If the given object is not parsable with `JSON.parse()`, we return an empty string.
